Summary: Offline implementation milestone for VBR 13.1 / REST 1.3-rev2 posture assessment. Seventeen common-capability controls are authored; live qualification and further planned controls remain pending.

Prerequisites.Text: Use Maester 3.0 (offline validation pins 3.0.0-rc83), PowerShell 7.4+, an approved HTTPS VBR origin, trusted certificate chain, and explicitly declared expected inventory.
No Azure provisioning is authorized until the next explicit approval. Read setup and limitations before installing this unfinished milestone.

Steps.Text: Configure VBR.Server in GlobalSettings and connect the dedicated VBR REST account.

Notes: OperationalReader is the default pack profile; documented Backup Viewer access still needs live visibility verification.
Administrator-only reads require explicit administrator opt-in. REST MFA may need disabling for this dedicated service account only, never all humans. Do not store credentials in configuration.

Commands.Text: Run only VBR tests. Direct native invocation is safe and uncached.

Notes: Empty expected inventory, missing evidence, or unsupported schemas do not imply compliance. Agent/VMware/Hyper-V share common policy semantics; no hypervisor connection is required.
Native configuration/runtime parameters expose approved overrides. Scoped caching uses the separately dot-sourced public assessment wrapper; see API-client documentation.

AppOnly.Text: VBR uses its own password/refresh OAuth lifecycle. Microsoft Graph application credentials and Azure managed identity do not authenticate to VBR. Managed identity is reserved for separately approved Azure operations.
